system.name: The Saturn System
system.description: A nested planetary system of Saturn, its rings, moons, and active environments.
system.scale_note: Orbit spacing, moon size, and rings are diagrammatic and not to scale.

atmosphere_classes.label: Tenuous exosphere
atmosphere_classes.description: An extremely sparse envelope of particles around a moon.

atmosphere_classes.label: Plume-sourced gas
atmosphere_classes.description: Transient gas and vapor supplied by active jets; not equivalent to a thick global atmosphere.

objects.name: Saturn
objects.summary: Parent world of this system. Its rings and moons form a complex local environment.

objects.name: Mimas
objects.summary: Small icy moon included as a system landmark. No atmosphere classification is asserted here.

objects.name: Enceladus
objects.summary: Jets at the south pole send water vapor and ice into space. Cassini sampled the plume gases.

objects.name: Tethys
objects.summary: Icy moon shown for orientation within Saturn's inner satellite system.

objects.name: Dione
objects.summary: Cassini detected a very thin atmosphere, around five trillion times less dense than Earth's surface atmosphere.

objects.name: Rhea
objects.summary: Cassini detected a very thin exosphere containing oxygen and carbon dioxide.

objects.name: Titan
objects.summary: The only moon known to have a substantial atmosphere; its surface pressure is about 60% greater than Earth's.

sources.label: NASA Saturn moons facts
sources.supports: Titan's substantial atmosphere; very thin atmospheres around Dione and Rhea.

sources.label: NASA Titan facts
sources.supports: Titan's dense atmosphere and surface pressure.

sources.label: NASA Rhea
sources.supports: Rhea's thin exosphere with oxygen and carbon dioxide.

sources.label: NASA Enceladus
sources.supports: South-polar plumes, water vapor, ice, and sampled plume gases.
